participants.note: asked whether the change is consistent with prior PRs and whether it works around broken encryption
objected that failing to unlock after encryption is a catastrophic failure requiring the wallet to halt rather than just log a warning

claims.harm: unlock failure after encryption indicates catastrophic corruption, and merely logging allows continued usage of a corrupted wallet where funds may be lost
claims.quote: If a wallet is successfully encrypted, and then we are unable to unlock it, that is a catastrophic failure. It means that the wallet is corrupted, and the funds are probably lost. This should really be an Assert or some failure mode which results in the wallet no longer being loaded and in use. Logging a warning is not the right thing to do.

result.notes: achow101 raised a blocking safety objection against merely logging on unlock failure instead of halting wallet usage. The author acknowledged logging may not be appropriate, but no fix has been pushed.
